notes.title: CozySudoku 1.4.3 Version Update
notes.notes: Security protection of Sudoku data, solving the problem of data storage errors

notes.title: Cozy Sudoku 0.1.2.6 Version Update
notes.notes:
Fix the bug that prevents achievements from being activated
Add a save backup feature
Correct the error that allows the number 0 to be input using the keyboard

notes.title: Cozy Sudoku 0.1.2.5 Version Update
notes.notes:
Fixed a series of display errors caused by Undo
Adjusted the theme color to make the grid easier to identify
Added Info prompt panel to prompt shortcut key information

notes.title: Cozy Sudoku 0.1.2.4 Version Update
notes.notes:
Fixed achievement bug
Fixed grid display bug
Adjusted theme colors and added highlight color for selected grids

notes.title: Cozy Sudoku Update Version 0.1.2.2
notes.notes:
Cozy Sudoku Update Version 0.1.2.2


 Added the ability to move the selected cell using the keyboard arrow keys.
 Added number selection using the numpad.
 Fixed an issue where toggling the music setting would cause a volume change error.
 Fixed the color display error of the same number in the peer area.
 Modified the display issue for Chinese, Japanese, and Korean on dates.
 Fixed the conflict between the F12 debug function and Steam's screenshot key.
